overview: A provenance register for Jewel of Africa that records each mined lot as a sealed, hash-chained block with a full chain of custody.
features: Register mined lots as sealed, hash-chained blocks
Append provenance events and change status with role-gated transitions
Search and explore the asset registry with stats and graphs
Admin panel for roles, permissions, reference data, documents and analytics
Admin-only deletion of individual blocks and full register purge
Per-role permission matrix with checkbox editing
